name: Schlegeisspeicher
kurzbeschreibung: The türkisblaue reservoir at 1,782 m elevation – one of Tirol’s most photographed natural sights, offering a breathtaking panorama.
beschreibung:
Overview

Lake Schlegeisspeicher rests as a monumental, turquoise alpine reservoir at an altitude of 1,782 meters in the upper Zillertal valley, nestled within the High Alps Nature Park Zillertal Alps. Flanked by the glaciated 3,000-meter sentinels of the main alpine ridge—dominated by the Olperer (3,476 m) and Hochfeiler—the artificial basin holds up to 126.5 million cubic meters of glacial meltwater powering clean hydroelectric generation for VERBUND AG. The architectural marvel is the monumental Schlegeis dam: standing 131 meters tall with a crest length of 725 meters, this double-curvature arch dam ranks among the most magnificent civil engineering structures in Europe. The reservoir draws hikers, mountaineers, and world travelers, renowned for vertical via ferratas bolted directly onto the dam face, underground engineering tours, and the globally viral suspension bridge at the Olpererhütte.

Route & Requirements

Activities around Lake Schlegeis range from level lakeside strolls to rigorous high-alpine scrambles. Families and casual visitors stroll along the flat western shore to the rustic alpine inn Zamsgatterl (45 minutes, easy grade T1, completely stroller friendly). The undisputed international hiking magnet is the trek to the Olpererhütte (2,389 m): departing the dam parking area, an engineered granite-stair trail climbs 600 vertical meters through alpine pastures to the mountain hut (1.5 to 2 hours, moderate grade T2). Just above the hut, the iconic timber suspension footbridge spans an alpine brook, framing a breathtaking backdrop over the turquoise lake far below. For vertical thrill-seekers, the "#Schlegeis131" via ferrata is built directly onto the vertical concrete face of the dam (grades B and C), featuring wire rope bridges and a 600-meter Flying Fox zip line. Guided tours explore the interior inspection corridors of the dam several times daily. Mountain boots and warm layers are vital. Leashed dogs are welcome along lakeside paths.

Visit & Arrival

Rail travelers ride the Zillertalbahn to Mayrhofen terminal station, connecting directly to regional VVT bus line 4102 running hourly from late May through October via Ginzling straight to the dam crest. Drivers take the Inntal autobahn A12 (exit Wiesing/Zillertal) and follow highway B169 to Mayrhofen, continuing south to Ginzling where the scenic 13.3-kilometer Schlegeis Alpine Toll Road begins (single-lane natural rock tunnels regulated by traffic lights). Ample pay parking is located atop the dam.

Tips

Join an interior dam tour to walk deep inside the concrete monolithic inspection tunnels and learn how engineers monitor the mountain forces. To photograph the world-famous suspension bridge beside Olpererhütte without crowds, begin your ascent early before 9:00 AM or book an overnight stay at the mountain hut.
preis: Kostenlos (Mautstraße Schlegeis ca. 15–17 € pro PKW; Staumauerführung ca. 6 €)
